name: cross-model-delegation
description: Delegate work from Claude Code to other model families: the Codex CLI (GPT-6 Astra, Sol, Luna, resolved from the live catalog) under seven pinned task classes, and Gemini 4 Argon through the Antigravity CLI for writing. Wrappers that own every flag, model-pinned agent templates, and an optional guard against raw CLI invocations. Also: a second Claude login side by side with shared configuration.
